channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Gilda Basque Tavern Coming To West Town, Prequel Cafe Expands And Other Food News
item.description: Chefs Jeremy Leven and Rafael Esparza are prepping to open their Basque-inspired restaurant on Chicago Avenue, Prequel Cafe is adding a to-go coffee shop and SeoulSpice Korean Kitchen is opening in Wicker Park.

item.title: SNAP Benefit Changes Are Now In Effect. Here’s What To Know And How To Find Food Help
item.description: New work restrictions and other changes to the country's food assistance program went into effect Sunday. Local food pantries are bracing for huge demand.

item.title: Historic Roseland Church, Once On Verge Of Demolition, To Become Black-Women-Led Medical Center
item.description: Onyx Health Collective, led by Dr. Maya Green and pharmacists Tonya Payton-Campbell and Ramona Burress, assumed ownership of Reformation Lutheran Church in November with plans to convert it into a health care hub called Onyx Commons.

item.title: How A South Side Woman Built A ‘MuSic Movement’ To Raise Money For Multiple Sclerosis Awareness
item.description: The locally organized event Saturday at 115 Bourbon Street will feature performances by Everclear and The Ron Burgundy's.

item.title: The Ultimate Guide To Chicago’s Big Pizzas: Deep-Dish, Stuffed, Pan And Double Decker
item.description: Venture deep into the city's garden of cheesy, crusty delights to learn what distinguishes our heftiest pizzas.

item.title: Mosaics Boutique And Tea To Close In Mount Greenwood
item.description: The tea shop will close in the coming weeks and is holding a close-out sale on products.

item.title: Noah Kahan Adds Wrigley Field Stop To Stadium Tour
item.description: The Vermont-born singer-songwriter joins John Mulaney and Tyler Childers on the stadium’s growing summer schedule.

item.title: Proposed 40-Unit Building On Humboldt Park-Ukrainian Village Border Wins Alderman’s Support
item.description: After three community meetings, Ald. Gilbert Villegas is backing a zoning change for the latest plan by Barrett Homes to redevelop a vacant lot at Chicago and Washtenaw avenues.

item.title: 12 Things To Do Outside In Chicago This February
item.description: Bundle Up for scenic winter hikes, Polar Adventure Day at Big Marsh Park and a Valentine’s Day-themed ice skating event.

item.title: Hundreds Of CPS Students Protest Federal Immigration Crackdown During School Walk-Out
item.description: At least 400 Chicago Public School students from across the North Side organized an afternoon school walk-out over the targeting of families in immigration raids. "We are fed up," one student said.
